description: This file provides a utility to map Unicode Latin characters to ASCII equivalents and to 'latinise' strings by replacing non-ASCII characters with their mapped ASCII counterparts.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a single Unicode Latin character to its ASCII equivalent using the latinMap dictionary.

methods.name: latinise
methods.description: Replaces all non-alphanumeric characters in a string with their ASCII equivalents based on the map function.
